name: dion-chat-docx
description: Browser extension that exports a dion.vc chat conversation to DOCX

scripts.test: npm run build && playwright test --config src/tests/playwright.config.js
scripts.test:yandex: npm run build && TEST_BROWSER=yandex playwright test --config src/tests/playwright.config.js
scripts.test:yandex:dom: npm run build && TEST_BROWSER=yandex playwright test --config src/tests/playwright.config.js -g 'Yandex runs the scraper'
